PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Meta.ConfigLabel: PainterlyNPR - Ground Cut: the Watercolour Swish Where an Elevation Is Cut at the Ground
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: An elevation cut off at the ground on a sheet ends as an illustrator ends one: a single swish of wash along the ground (a dark sweep of lawn, a sandy band of hardstanding), the drawing's foot lost into it, sometimes a ruled ground line. Every length is millimetres on the sheet; the swish is painted the way the wash is (paper times each pigment to the power of its density).
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Meta.Source: New in v0.8.13 (30-Oct-2026), for ValeVision AURA's elevation viewports. Adam: "create a realistic parametric version of that for elevation viewports specifically"

PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Kinds.OrderNote: The order a wrapper's menu lists them in. Plain is the hard cut: no swish and no lost foot.
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Kinds.DefaultNote: The kind a cut starts as before anyone picks one: most Vale elevations stand on lawn.

GrassSweep.Label: Grass sweep
GrassSweep.Hint: A bold sweep of dark green under the planting, heavy at one end and lifting off at the other

GrassStrip.Label: Grass strip
GrassStrip.Hint: A thin, level band of green just past each end of the building

Hardstanding.Label: Hardstanding
Hardstanding.Hint: A sandy wash in marker streaks, a heavy rounded end, dry-brushed away to nothing at the other

Gravel.Label: Gravel
Gravel.Hint: A warm grey wash flecked with darker stones

Paving.Label: Paving
Paving.Hint: A stone wash with a few faint joints, under a ruled ground line

Plain.Label: Plain cut
Plain.Hint: The drawing stops at the edge, nothing added

PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Kinds.KindsNote: Values are a kind's starting look: a wrapper keeps only what has been moved from them. Colours lists the colours offered for it, Colour the one it starts with; InkLine whether it starts with a ruled ground line.

PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Colours.ColoursNote: Pigment and Pigment2 are TRANSMITTANCE colours, as the material classes' are: what one unit of density does to white paper. The swish mixes the two by a slow noise. Material takes both from that material class (13), so the swish matches the drawing's own wash of it.

PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Control.OrderNote: Every control a wrapper shows for a cut, in its order. A Range's value lives in the settings' Values; InkLine, a Toggle, on the settings themselves.

ThicknessMm.Label: Thickness
ThicknessMm.Hint: How deep the swish is where it is fullest

OverlapMm.Label: Overlap
OverlapMm.Hint: How far its top edge rides up over the drawing's foot; below 0 a sliver of paper is left between them

ReachLeftMm.Label: Reach, left
ReachLeftMm.Hint: How far it runs past the frame's left side; below 0 it stops short of it

ReachRightMm.Label: Reach, right
ReachRightMm.Hint: How far it runs past the frame's right side; below 0 it stops short of it

SweepMm.Label: Sweep
SweepMm.Hint: How far its light end curves up as the brush sweeps off (down, below 0)

HeavyAt.Label: Heavy end
HeavyAt.Hint: Where the stroke is fullest: 0% its left end, 100% its right (before Flip)

Taper.Label: Taper
Taper.Hint: How much of its length the light end takes to thin to nothing

Strength.Label: Strength
Strength.Hint: How much pigment: the wash's density

Streaks.Label: Brush streaks
Streaks.Hint: The bristles' and the marker's passes along the stroke

EdgeDarkening.Label: Edge darkening
EdgeDarkening.Hint: The darker rim where the wash dried, and the paler band inside it

DryBrush.Label: Dry brush
DryBrush.Hint: How broken the light end becomes as the brush runs dry

Wobble.Label: Wobble
Wobble.Hint: How irregular its edges and its depth are

Speckle.Label: Speckle
Speckle.Hint: Small darker touches in the wash: gravel's stones, flecks in a lawn

Joints.Label: Joints
Joints.Hint: Faint joints across paving, one every few millimetres

LoseMm.Label: Lost foot
LoseMm.Hint: How far up the drawing's foot breaks up into the swish; 0 is the frame's hard cut

InkLine.Label: Ink ground line
InkLine.Hint: A ruled ground line along the cut, in the drawing's ink and its ground pen

PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.SeedLabelNote: A cut with no seed of its own takes one derived from this and its identity (a wrapper's viewport id), so it never changes until New swish gives it one.
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.CapRatioNote: The heavy end's round landing, as a share of the thickness
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.RoundTaperBelowNote: A Taper under this ends the light end round as well, as a strip is
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.SwellNote: How much thinner it is at its heavy end than where it is fullest
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.BottomEdgeGainNote: The lower edge wanders more than the top, which follows the ground
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.EdgeGrainMmNote: How far the paper's tooth breaks an edge in or out
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.StreakPitchMmNote: The bristles' spacing across the stroke at full thickness; they close up in the taper as a brush's do
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.PassDepthNote: The marker's overlapping passes: wider, softer bands than the bristles'
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.UnloadNote: How much less pigment reaches the light end than the heavy one
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.RimFromMmNote: The rim fades out where the stroke is thinner than this, so a dry tail never darkens
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.InkOvershootMmNote: The ground line runs this far past the frame's sides, as a ruled line overshoots its corner
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.InkCategoryNote: The ground line takes the Ground pen of this category in the technical pens' semantics (0.35 mm)
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Paintin.FootFloorNote: Where the foot is lost least, the share of Lost foot still lost

PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Output.PreviewPxPerMmNote: Pixels a millimetre while a slider is dragged: quick, then the full density once it rests
PainterlyNPR__GroundCut__Config__Output.MaxPixelsNote: A swish or a foot larger than this is painted at a lower density, never refused
